criteria.requirement: Extend add_toc_hook with include_nested=False and support renderer=None AST mode. Preserve default top-level heading selection, explicit/custom IDs, allocator collision handling and level bounds. When opted in, walk block-container descendants in source preorder; normalize AST heading display text through completed PlainTextRenderer. Expose real state.env["toc_items"] and assigned heading IDs without HTML renderer assertions. Inline normalization must use an isolated environment so collecting metadata does not register additional footnote references or mutate document plugin state.
